16/// The inner representation of an external graphics state.
17#[derive(Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq, Default, Clone)]
18struct Repr {
19    /// The non-stroking alpha.
20    non_stroking_alpha: Option<NormalizedF32>,
21    /// The stroking alpha.
22    stroking_alpha: Option<NormalizedF32>,
23    /// The blend mode.
24    blend_mode: Option<BlendMode>,
25    /// An active mask.
26    mask: Option<Ref>,
27    /// Fill overprint (`/op`).
28    overprint_fill: Option<bool>,
29    /// Stroke overprint (`/OP`).
30    overprint_stroke: Option<bool>,
31    /// Overprint mode (`/OPM`).
32    overprint_mode: Option<OverprintMode>,
33}
34
35/// A graphics state containing information about
36/// - The current stroking alpha.
37/// - The current non-stroking alpha.
38/// - The current blend mode.
39/// - The current mask.
40/// - The current overprint settings.
41///
42/// This struct provides exposes a builder pattern for setting the various properties
43/// individually.
44///
45/// This type is cheap to clone.
46#[derive(Debug, Clone, Hash, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
47pub(crate) struct ExtGState(Arc<Repr>);
48
49impl ExtGState {
50    /// Create a new, empty graphics state.
51    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
52        Self::default()
53    }
54
55    /// Create a new graphics state with a stroking alpha.
56    #[must_use]
57    pub(crate) fn stroking_alpha(mut self, stroking_alpha: NormalizedF32) -> Self {
58        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).stroking_alpha = Some(stroking_alpha);
59        self
60    }
61
62    /// Create a new graphics state with a non-stroking alpha.
63    #[must_use]
64    pub(crate) fn non_stroking_alpha(mut self, non_stroking_alpha: NormalizedF32) -> Self {
65        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).non_stroking_alpha = Some(non_stroking_alpha);
66        self
67    }
68
69    /// Create a new graphics state with a blend mode.
70    #[must_use]
71    pub(crate) fn blend_mode(mut self, blend_mode: BlendMode) -> Self {
72        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).blend_mode = Some(blend_mode);
73        self
74    }
75
76    /// Create a new graphics state with fill and stroke overprint and an overprint mode.
77    #[must_use]
78    pub(crate) fn overprint(mut self, fill: bool, stroke: bool, mode: OverprintMode) -> Self {
79        let repr = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0);
80        repr.overprint_fill = Some(fill);
81        repr.overprint_stroke = Some(stroke);
82        repr.overprint_mode = Some(mode);
83        self
84    }
85
86    /// Create a new graphics state with a mask.
87    #[must_use]
88    pub(crate) fn mask(mut self, mask: Mask, sc: &mut SerializeContext, chunk_container: &mut ChunkContainer) -> Self {
89        let mask_ref = sc.register_cacheable(chunk_container, mask);
90        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).mask = Some(mask_ref);
91        self
92    }
93
94    /// Check whether the graphics state is empty.
95    pub(crate) fn empty(&self) -> bool {
96        self.0.mask.is_none()
97            && self.0.stroking_alpha.is_none()
98            && self.0.non_stroking_alpha.is_none()
99            && self.0.blend_mode.is_none()
100            && self.0.overprint_fill.is_none()
101            && self.0.overprint_stroke.is_none()
102            && self.0.overprint_mode.is_none()
103    }
104
105    /// Integrate another graphics state into the current one. This is done by replacing
106    /// all active properties of the other graphics state in the current graphics state, while
107    /// leaving the inactive ones unchanged.
108    pub(crate) fn combine(&mut self, other: &ExtGState) {
109        if let Some(stroking_alpha) = other.0.stroking_alpha {
110            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).stroking_alpha = Some(stroking_alpha);
111        }
112
113        if let Some(non_stroking_alpha) = other.0.non_stroking_alpha {
114            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).non_stroking_alpha = Some(non_stroking_alpha);
115        }
116
117        if let Some(blend_mode) = other.0.blend_mode {
118            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).blend_mode = Some(blend_mode);
119        }
120
121        if let Some(mask) = other.0.mask {
122            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).mask = Some(mask);
123        }
124
125        if let Some(fill) = other.0.overprint_fill {
126            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).overprint_fill = Some(fill);
127        }
128
129        if let Some(stroke) = other.0.overprint_stroke {
130            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).overprint_stroke = Some(stroke);
131        }
132
133        if let Some(mode) = other.0.overprint_mode {
134            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).overprint_mode = Some(mode);
135        }
136    }
137}
138
139impl Cacheable for ExtGState {
140    fn serialize(self, sc: &mut SerializeContext, chunk_container: &mut ChunkContainer, root_ref: Ref) {
141        let chunk = &mut chunk_container.non_stream.ext_g_states;
142
143        let mut ext_st = chunk.ext_graphics(root_ref);
144        if let Some(nsa) = self.0.non_stroking_alpha {
145            if nsa != NormalizedF32::ONE {
146                sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::Transparency(sc.location));
147                sc.mark_transparent(root_ref);
148            }
149
150            ext_st.non_stroking_alpha(nsa.get());
151        }
152
153        if let Some(sa) = self.0.stroking_alpha {
154            if sa != NormalizedF32::ONE {
155                sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::Transparency(sc.location));
156                sc.mark_transparent(root_ref);
157            }
158
159            ext_st.stroking_alpha(sa.get());
160        }
161
162        if let Some(bm) = self.0.blend_mode {
163            if bm != BlendMode::Normal {
164                sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::Transparency(sc.location));
165                sc.mark_transparent(root_ref);
166            }
167
168            ext_st.blend_mode(bm);
169        }
170
171        if let Some(mask_ref) = self.0.mask {
172            sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::Transparency(sc.location));
173            sc.mark_transparent(root_ref);
174
175            ext_st.pair(Name(b"SMask"), mask_ref);
176        }
177
178        if let Some(fill) = self.0.overprint_fill {
179            ext_st.overprint_fill(fill);
180        }
181
182        if let Some(stroke) = self.0.overprint_stroke {
183            ext_st.overprint(stroke);
184        }
185
186        if let Some(mode) = self.0.overprint_mode {
187            // Under `no_device_cs` all CMYK is ICCBased, which PDF/A-2 and later forbid with
188            // OPM 1 when that side overprints. The colors painted under this state aren't
189            // known here, so any overprinting side counts.
190            let overprints = self.0.overprint_fill == Some(true) || self.0.overprint_stroke == Some(true);
191            if mode == OverprintMode::IgnoreZeroChannel && overprints && sc.serialize_settings().no_device_cs {
192                sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::OverprintModeIccCmyk(sc.location));
193            }
194
195            ext_st.overprint_mode(mode);
196        }
197
198        ext_st.finish();
199    }
200}
201
202impl Resourceable for ExtGState {
203    type Resource = resource::ExtGState;
204}

206/// A simulation of the PDF graphics state, so that we
207/// can write our transforms/graphics state all at once
208/// when adding an image/path instead of having to
209/// use `save_state`/`restore_state` excessively.
210#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]
211pub(crate) struct GraphicsState {
212    ext_g_state: ExtGState,
213    ctm: Transform,
214}
215impl Eq for GraphicsState {}
216
217impl Hash for GraphicsState {
218    fn hash<H: std::hash::Hasher>(&self, state: &mut H) {
219        self.ext_g_state.hash(state);
220        self.ctm.hash(state);
221    }
222}
223
224impl Default for GraphicsState {
225    fn default() -> Self {
226        Self { ext_g_state: ExtGState::new(), ctm: Transform::identity() }
227    }
228}
229
230impl GraphicsState {
231    pub(crate) fn combine(&mut self, other: &ExtGState) {
232        self.ext_g_state.combine(other);
233    }
234
235    pub(crate) fn concat_transform(&mut self, transform: Transform) {
236        self.ctm = self.ctm.pre_concat(transform);
237    }
238
239    pub(crate) fn transform(&self) -> Transform {
240        self.ctm
241    }
242
243    pub(crate) fn ext_g_state(&self) -> &ExtGState {
244        &self.ext_g_state
245    }
246}
247
248/// A collection of graphics states, simulates the stack-like
249/// structure used.
250#[derive(Debug, Hash, Eq, PartialEq)]
251pub struct GraphicsStates {
252    graphics_states: Vec<GraphicsState>,
253}
254
255impl GraphicsStates {
256    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
257        GraphicsStates { graphics_states: vec![GraphicsState::default()] }
258    }
259
260    pub(crate) fn cur(&self) -> &GraphicsState {
261        self.graphics_states.last().unwrap()
262    }
263
264    pub(crate) fn cur_mut(&mut self) -> &mut GraphicsState {
265        self.graphics_states.last_mut().unwrap()
266    }
267
268    pub(crate) fn save_state(&mut self) {
269        let state = self.cur();
270        self.graphics_states.push(state.clone())
271    }
272
273    pub(crate) fn restore_state(&mut self) {
274        self.graphics_states.pop();
275    }
276
277    pub(crate) fn combine(&mut self, other: &ExtGState) {
278        self.cur_mut().combine(other);
279    }
280
281    pub(crate) fn transform(&mut self, transform: Transform) {
282        self.cur_mut().concat_transform(transform);
283    }
284
285    pub(crate) fn transform_bbox(&self, bbox: Rect) -> Rect {
286        // Important: This does not take the root transform of the
287        // corresponding ContentBuilder into account, because we
288        // want it to be in krilla coordinates, not in PDF
289        // coordinates.
290        bbox.transform(self.cur().transform()).unwrap()
291    }
292}
